name: questions.integrations_apis.baseline
description: Baseline questions for API surface, external integrations, and event delivery.

questions.text: What is the primary public API style?
questions.rationale: API style influences client SDKs, versioning strategy, and testing approach.

questions.text: List the key external integrations (CRM, payments, analytics, etc.) and roughly how they're consumed.
questions.rationale: External dependencies are a common source of latency, reliability, and compliance risk.

questions.text: How are breaking API changes versioned and communicated?
questions.rationale: Versioning maturity is a proxy for whether consumers can safely depend on the API.

questions.text: Is there rate-limiting, quota, or circuit-breaker protection on external integrations?
questions.rationale: Missing guards turn third-party outages into full-system outages.

questions.text: How are asynchronous events / webhooks delivered (message bus, outbox, direct)?
questions.rationale: Delivery guarantees determine data consistency risk across service boundaries.
